# netbox_export_template (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
// Get an export template by name
data "netbox_export_template" "by_name" {
  name = "site-names"
}

// Get an export template by ID
data "netbox_export_template" "by_id" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.
- `name` (String) At least one of `id` or `name` must be given.

### Read-Only

- `as_attachment` (Boolean)
- `content_types` (Set of String)
- `description` (String)
- `file_extension` (String)
- `mime_type` (String)
- `template_code` (String)
